"Check out Brand new IVM 6115 from Innoson, the First Locally-made CNG ‘Gas-powered’ Vehicle in Nigeria

Innoson Motors has finally unveiled the IVM CITY BUS 6115, the first indigenous manufactured CNG vehicle in Nigeria. The 55 Seater IVM CITY BUS 6115 uses Condensed Natural Gas (CNG) as fuel. This auto fuel is cleaner and 50 per cent cheaper than traditional fuels such as diesel and petrol. 

Innoson is producing 100 units of CNG city buses for the Nigerian National Petroleum Company (NNPC). According to Innoson, the CNG-powered buses will help cushion the effects of this year’s planned fuel subsidy removal.

"The winner of the Gulder Ultimate Search Age of Craftsmanship Season 12 is going to be presented with a brand new car.

This was confirmed by Nigerian Breweries PLC., the organizers of the survival reality TV show.

When it was announced that the show will be returning, it was met with excitement and enthusiasm from Nigerians with the topic dominating social media conversation.

More than 20,000 Nigerians applied for the show. Following the regional selection process, those who qualified were sent to the Sea School where another rigorous selection process took place. Ultimately, 20 contestants made the shortlist which comprised 16 confirmed contestants and 4 wildcards. Two wildcards eventually made it into the jungle.

The contestants were grouped into three clans: Irin, Amo, and Iroko in the first few weeks in Amorokin camp where they engaged in group tasks that tested their ability to work as a member of a team for collective success.

The clan formation was ended and replaced with individual tasks where participants were solely responsible for their successes and failures.

According to Nigerian Breweries, the Gulder Ultimate Search Winner is expected to go home with N50 million worth of prizes which includes N20 million naira cash prize, Innoson G5T SUV and Air Peace return flight tickets to Dubai. 

Consumers and fans of the show also have an opportunity to win cars with details on that to be communicated when the GUS Winner’s tour commences in 2022.

Maria Shadeko, Portfolio Manager Flavoured, Non-Lager, And Craft, Nigerian Breweries said everyone who participated in the show has shown their winning spirit.

"The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Ltd has contracted Innoson Vehicle Motors (IVM) to produce Condensed Natural Gas (CNG) cars, the founder of the indigenous car manufacturer has disclosed.

Innocent Chukwuma, the Chairman of Innoson Group, while speaking to local station, Arise TV, revealed that IVM has been contracted to manufacture cars for the NNPC.

The Nigerian government had unveiled plans to sponsor the conversion of one million cars to run on gas, as Nigeria seeks to make the transition to cleaner fuel.

NNPC CEO, Mele Kyari, had announced in December 2020 that the Ministry of Petroleum will provide the structure for the free conversion services to enable automobiles switch from petrol to gas.

“I am now producing some vehicles with CNG engine for NNPC. I am almost through with the production and I did the best quality of the CNG cars and it was built from my factory,” said the IVM boss on Friday. “CNG will help everybody because the consumption of CNG is better than fuel. If people can convert to CNG, it will benefit the nation, transport cost will drop down. Nigeria has a lot of CNG wasting.”

The billionaire businessman was also optimistic of venturing into the production of electric cars.

“The most important thing that I am doing in a vehicle is to build the body, I don’t produce engines; I import engines from engine companies” he said. “If I want to do electric vehicle, it is the same vehicle, I will buy the battery and other things. It is the same thing, so, electric vehicle is nothing; I can do it easily, because I have the capacity do it. It is very easy. But it is when the demand comes that I will start.”

Chukwuma said GTBank, which has restructured into a subsidiary of Guaranty Trust Holding Company (GTCO) owes him N32 billion, and its accruing 22 percent interest.

The automaker had been in a court battle with the Miriam Onasanya-led bank, and requested the Federal High Court in Lagos to prevent GTBank from restructuring into GTCO, but that didn’t stop the process.

The Innoson boss had filed and won suit FHC/L/Cs/603/2006 and FHC/Cs/139/2012. Seven years later, Chukwuma claimed that the court had ordered he can take over GTBank, but the lender dismissed his claim.

"Innocent Chukwuma, chairman, Innoson Group, says he is waiting to take over the assets of Guaranty Trust Bank (GTB) due to “non-payment of his N32 billion”.

Chukwuma, in an interview with journalists on Tuesday, said the money owed him by the bank would soon surpass their capacity.

Innoson and GTB have had a business dispute leading to a prolonged legal battle.

Innoson had secured judgment debt against the bank in suit FHC/L/Cs/603/2006 and FHC/Cs/139/2012 respectively, which rose to over N32 billion due to accumulated interest.

In July, Innoson had asked a federal high court in Lagos to set aside an order permitting GTB to restructure to a holding company.

But the bank completed the restructuring — GTB is now known as Guaranty Trust Holding Company Plc (GTCO Plc).

The billionaire businessman, at the media briefing, recounted that his relationship with the bank had been extremely cordial during the tenure of Olutayo Aderinokun, late MD of GTB.

“I was GTBANK’s best customer in the south-east when Tayo, the former MD, was alive. Because of this, they opened a branch in Nnewi. After Tayo, the new MD took over. I don’t even know him. I saw him for the first time last year,” Chukuma said.

“They started fighting about tribe. I am not certain about this but I think the reason he (GTB) is fighting is because of tribe. I don’t know exactly what his problem is.

Innoson Manufacturing Company Limited says a 15th-anniversary promo notice making the rounds is false and did not emanate from it. Members of the public are hereby notified that Innoson Vehicles does not and will not require anybody to respond to such a questionnaire in the name of winning a raffle. Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing Co. Ltd. is a Nigerian automobile manufacturer headquartered in Nnewi, Anambra, Nigeria. It was founded in 2007 by Chief Innocent Chukwuma Nwala and so far has been nicknamed the Pride Of African Road giving the fact that it produces high quality and affordable cars of international standards. It should be noted that 70% of the car parts are produced locally, while the rest is sourced from Japan, China, and Germany. "Beware of Scam Land Deals...

SHARE?

While there are many genuine land deals in the market, you have to be careful so you do not fall into the hands of scammers.

Here are 4 ways you can spot scam land deals

1. There is NO valid document to show ownership of the land.

2. It is usually difficult for you to get the exact size & boundary of the land.

3. Too many people claim ownership of the land.

4. In some cases, these scammers sweet talk you and delay/refuse physical site inspection.

"Keeping your Tyres properly inflated.
Under or over-inflated Tyres may not brake, accelerate or steer properly. Tyre pressure is advised to be checked at least once a month when the Tyres are cold.

The most important factor in a TYRE is a proper inflation.
The inflation pressure imprinted on the sidewall of a TYRE is the maximum operating pressure determined by the TYRE manufacturer. Moreover, it's not necessarily the correct inflation for your vehicle TYRES.
It is advisable you always use the inflation recommended by your vehicle manufacturer, which you can find the information in the owners manual and often on the label located by the vehicle door jam.

"Anambra 2021: Valentine Ozigbo Adds @officialinnosonvehicles To Campaign Fleet

 Valentine Ozigbo, the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) frontrunner for the Anambra governorship election, on Tuesday, May 4, 2021, reiterated his belief that Anambra can be the most significant industrial hub in Africa if the state elects a visionary and transformation leader come November.

Mr. Ozigbo made the assertion when he took a tour of the Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing (IVM) factory in Nnewi, Anambra State. He purchased an IVM pick-up truck during the visit, demonstrating his belief in the Innoson and made-in-Nigeria products.

He declared that purchasing an Innoson vehicle shows that he “walks his talk” and “puts his money where his mouth is”.

While speaking during the visit, Ozigbo hailed the Founder and CEO of the Innoson Group, Chief Innocent Chukwuma, as a pioneer who is taking steps to actualize the great possibilities in Nigeria and Africa.

According to the respected business leader, Chief Chukwuma exemplifies how black people can change their story, adding that similar business ventures would see Nigeria implement import substitution and create employment for millions of Nigerians.

Ozigbo, who is the immediate past President and Group CEO of Transcorp Plc, further spoke on his grand vision for Anambra State. He highlighted his 5-Cluster development plan, which would see Nnewi and its environs be rapidly transformed into one of Africa’s biggest industrial hubs.

“In our Ka Anambra Chawapu Manifesto, we detailed our plans to industrialise Anambra State and we have designated Nnewi to be the epi-center of this revolution,” Ozigbo said.

Ozigbo also emphasised that the DNA of his administration, if he is elected, will be to place Anambra first in every policy and action. “Buy Anambra, will be my government’s mantra,” he said.

In his reaction, Chief Innocent Chukwuma thanked Mr. Ozigbo for his visit and patronage. The ace industrialist described Ozigbo as a “game-changer” and wished him well in his governorship aspiration.

"In its avowed commitment to the incremental enhancement of the nation's economy, INNOSON VEHICLE MANUFACTURING is set to launch its brand of ride-hailing service, @ivmcruise 

This new service offering from the company is set to commence from the city of #Enugu with other cities consecutively coming on stream.

The #IVMCruise ride-hailing service from Nigeria's foremost vehicle manufacturing company is unique as it offers drivers, aptly named pilots, a chance of becoming owners of brand new #Innoson vehicles after a period of 3 years in which the cost of these vehicles would have been paid. 

IVM Cruise is a technology-driven ride-hailing service. It offers commuters a platform for requesting pickups and drop-offs from their various locations to their destinations.

The service is designed to operate on an incremental digital architecture in line with modern trends in the city transportation industry.

Innoson's IVM Cruise ride-hailing service features:
- a digital wallet payment system, 
-an offline payment facility, 
-an interactive user interface/application for both pilots and commuters
-ease of usage
-a personalized experience which is customized to each subscriber of the IVM Cruise app 
-a pilot interface system which directs pilots to areas within the city where there are increased subscriber requests.

This technology enables a subscriber to enjoy the IVM Cruise experience in few minutes from requesting a ride. 

As a foremost wholly-owned Nigerian vehicle manufacturing company, Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing Ltd is poised to create avenues for deepening societal development through transportation while ensuring dignity to Nigerian transporters.

Cornel Osigwe. 
Head of Corporate Communications & Affairs
IVM Innoson Group

* The power steering

*Power windows
*Central lock system

  The all purpose SUV IKENGA has high power output,low fuel consumption and low exhaust emissions..

?

?
IVM will give the hailing app a fleet of buses to boost its growth in the eastern part of Nigeria.?
?
Any of the partners didn’t specify the exact number of buses.?
?

"Lagos State Police Command have arrested two operatives of the Federal Special Anti-Robbery Squad (FSARS) Inspector Sale James, Inspector Monday Uchiola and their civilian accomplice Okechukwu Ogbonna, for acts of professional misconduct including extortion and intimidation of innocent citizens.

Force spokesperson, DCP Frank Mba, who confirmed the arrest in a statement on Sunday, October 4, said the operational vehicle of the men has also been impounded and disciplinary procedure has already commenced against the defaulters.

""The IGP reaffirms his commitment to bequeathing to Nigerians, a reformed Police Force that is accountable, responsible and ever ready to defend and uphold the rights of the citizens while discharging its duties of keeping the people safe and secure,"" said Mba.

He enjoined the citizens not to allow the misconduct by a few personnel of the Force to negatively impact on their belief, confidence and trust in the Police.

The maximum speed of this SUV is 150 km/h.

 The fuel capacity is 80 liters.

The IVM G40 is equipped with dual airbags, features power controlled seat-belts and a sedan style interior.

It was designed to provide the highest degree of space and comfort.

It comes with an electronic immobilizer system which enhances vehicle security.

"Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing

Nigerian manufacturer of automobilies and buses

Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing Co. Ltd., shortened as IVM, is a Nigerian automobile and bus manufacturing company. It was founded by Innocent Chukwuma Nwala, and runs a plant in Nnewi in the state of Anambra. Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing is nicknamed Pride Of African Road.

70% of the car parts are produced locally, while the rest is sourced from Japan, China, and Germany.

Among IVM's vehicle models are the five-seaters Fox (1.5-litre engine) and Umu (2-litre engine) as well as the mini-bus Uzo.

Global Presence.

Innoson vehicles are being used in some West African countries like: Mali, Sierra Leone and Ghana.

Brand Ambassador Mercy Eke, the first female winner of Big brother naija show, is currently the brand ambassador for Innoson Vehicles.

Innoson New Logo: A Nigerian Youth Osuolale Farouq was invited by the Company CEO Innocent Chukwuma after he re-designed and shared an improved and attracting logo for Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing on Twitter.

"Innoson Vehicles Confirms Huge Patronage From Federal Government

Indigenous vehicle manufacturing plant, Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing (IVM), has confirmed huge patronage from the Federal Government of Nigeria.

The company made the confirmation in a tweet Wednesday night.

It reacted to a tweet which claimed that the Federal Road Safety Corps, Federal Fire Service, Nigeria Police Force and the Nigerian Army all use Made-in-Nigeria vehicles from Innoson. “Fact,” it tweeted.

Fact https://t.co/7XI8zxO5R8 — Innoson Vehicles (@innosonvehicles) June 3, 2020

Innoson firefighting vehicles
The Nigerian Air Force (NAF) recently announced a partnership deal with IVM, which will see the company supply spare parts for jets conducting airstrikes against the insurgents.
“The ingenious effort by IVM is instrumental to the continued operation of the Alpha Jets,” NAF,  spokesperson, said of the deal.
“IVM helped to save the day when help was not forthcoming from abroad.” Innoson army vehicles
However, the Federal Government has often been criticised for not patronising the local vehicle manufacturing company enough.

Earlier in February 2020, several Nigerians took to Twitter to express their displeasure over news that members of the House of Representatives had chosen to buy foreign cars as utility vehicles, ignoring local vehicle manufacturer like Innoson.

The lawmakers had resolved to purchase 400 units of Toyota Camry 2020 model.

But on Wednesday and Thursday, Nigerians on Twitter commended the Federal Government for its recent patronage of Innoson vehicles.

"Eight Things You Need To Know Before Buying Your First Investment Property
Cont'd

2. Do your research.

Depending on the clients you are targeting, you need to do proper research before buying your first investment property. Make sure that the property is situated in a location that will attract the type of clients you hope to sell or rent to, that it will reach to the returns you are expecting and that it will appeal to the market. "Innoson Shares 1000 Bags Of Rice, An Ambulance To Anambra [Swipe]
-
The Chairman of IVM Innoson Group, Chief Dr. Innocent Chukwuma has donated an IVM Medical Ambulance to the Anambra State Government to support the State Government effort in containing the COVID-19 pandemic.
-
At the onset of the outbreak of the Coronavirus, Innoson Vehicles channeled its strength and manpower towards the massive production of medical ambulances and as well giving out massive discounts as a way of support to different state governments and corporate institutions that placed purchase orders for medical ambulances.
-
However, as a result of the first index case of the COVID-19 patient recorded in Anambra and to support the various measures being undertaken by the State Government, The Innoson Group Chairman, has donated an IVM Medical Ambulance to the Anambra State Government to help it contain the COVID-19 pandemic spread.
-
On the other hand, Innoson also donated over 1000 bags of rice to be distributed to the less privilege across all villages in Nnewi, to help cushion the effects of coronavirus lockdown.
-
Presenting the bags of rice on Saturday 11th, April 2020, on behalf of Chief Dr. Innocent Chukwuma, Mr. Austin Manuel said that the distribution was one part of tens of Innoson's contributions towards alleviating the effects of COVID-19 lockdown.
-
Mr. Austin Manuel urged all stakeholders within and beyond Nnewi, to support government efforts in the fight against the spread of coronavirus.
-
He advised the President-Generals who are representing their different communities in Nnewi, to ensure that the bags of rice are properly distributed to the less privileged.
-
Thanking Chief Innocent Chukwuma on behalf of Nnewi Community, the President-General of Nzuko-Ora Nnewi, Chief Sir Ugochukwu Udemezu (Ifeneti) appreciated Innoson for his kinds gesture, noting that the bags of rice will help cushion the effects for the less privileged.

"Nigeria's very own Tesla? It's not Innoson

I can never forget that epic commercial by BankPHB back in the day that said, ""one day cars will run on water."" We have electric cars already, maybe soon water powered cars. While this is realistic for the western world, it's almost unthinkable in Nigeria. But the same bank told us too that ""Impossible"" doesn't exist.

Innoson Motors, Nigeria's first indigenous car maker is miles away from winning the hearts of Nigerians who have are still faithful in their love affair with foreign vehicles. Thirteen years on and Innoson's task hasn't gotten any easier against the more trusted, stylish, and high performance foreign brands. Now, it's another indigenous car maker that surfaced in 2017 that is threatening to take pole position.

Jet Motors. It may have just one vehicle model so far; it's stylish luxury van, but it has made quite an impression. Innoson and Jet Motors certainly share similar value propositions for their target market: low pricing, reinforced shock absorbers for the rough African roads, and fuel economy. But Jet Motors might just have an edge. It's design looks more superior, stylish, and luxurious, and they are customizable as well. It's only one vehicle for now but other models (sedans, SUV, etc.) are in the works and if they are going to look as good as the first vehicle, then Innoson will have to come up with something different, unique and superior to be able to compete. 
Even more, Jet Motors are looking forward to introducing electric cars that can travel 300km (Lagos to Edo) and they plan to use GIGM as charging terminals. Nigeria is not the most favourable country for electric cars but we would see how it plays out.

"Reps Order 400 Exotic Cars, Reject Nigerian Brands

The House of Representatives has resolved to acquire Toyota Camry 2020 model for members as official cars, otherwise called utility vehicles.
The resolution was reached at an executive (closed-door) session held on February 5, 2020, The PUNCH reliably learnt on Friday.

A source in the chamber, who spoke on condition of anonymity as members were forbidden from disclosing details of the discussions at the closed-door meeting, said the National Assembly would purchase 400 exotic cars. The lawmaker, however, kept mum on the cost of each car.

When contacted on Sunday, a representative of Elizade Nigeria Limited, a foremost Toyota brand distributor, said the 2020 model had yet to arrive in the country.
The representative, however, said the 2019 model was N26.75m and N35.75m (for V6 engine).
The 2020 model is expected to be costlier.

A check on the website of Toyota showed that the price of the car, depending on the variants, is between $25,000 (N9,000,000 at N360 to a dollar) and $35,000 (N12,600,000), excluding the cost of shipping, import duty which is 70 per cent of the net cost and other clearing charges and taxes at the port.

For instance, those with higher specification, as the National Assembly usually goes for higher range of vehicles, are XLE at $29,455; XLE V6 at $34,580; XSE at $30,005 and XSE V6 at $35,130.

At the meeting, the lawmakers were said to have rejected Nigerian brands, insisting on foreign ones, preferably imported and not locally assembled.

The lawmaker said a proposal to patronise Innoson Vehicles Manufacturing, a Nigerian brand based in Nnewi, Anambra State, was rejected.

The lawmaker said, “It is Toyota Camry 2020. Manga will supply 300 of the vehicles. The person who supplied the Senate will supply the remaining 100. Someone suggested Innoson. I feel he was being sarcastic. He is from Anambra.” Already, about 14 Toyota Land Cruiser Prado Jeeps were said to have already been shared to the presiding and principal officers as well as chairmen of select House committees.

"Nigerian government has said it is in talks with indigenous automobile maker and two other firms that expressed interest in producing ventilators to combat the #coronavirus pandemic.

The Minister of Industry, Trade and Investment, Mr. Adeniyi Adebayo, confirmed the discussion to journalists on Monday.

He disclosed that following the expression of interest proposal sent in by Innoson Group seeking government’s commitment, the latter had expressed willingness to engage the car manufacturer in the area of manufacturing the much-needed ventilators.

The minister, who also noted that the government had also engaged the manufacturer Association of Nigeria in the areas of local production of foods and pharmaceutical products, needed to fight #covi?d19 was confident of the partnership working efficiently.

He said, “The coronavirus #pandemic has exposed the world to health and economic crises, and countries are shutting down their borders. We’ve thrown that challenge to our manufacturer and they are responding accordingly.” Adebayo noted that the ministry had opened Emergency Operation Centre to help in sorting out manufacturer’ challenges of moving their food or pharmaceutical products from the point of production to where they are needed.

"Aba Made / Nigerian made : What is wrong with it ? 
Preference for foreign goods is one thing we inherited from the colonial times. They pay peanuts prices/take our raw materials e.g. cocoa,rubber,palm produce e.t.c then take it abroad to reproduce whatever then bring the finished goods to the African market to sell at exhubitant prices. After the shackles were broken(#Independence), we're still economically and mentally tied to the western economy which slows down our economy.
.
This nonchalant attitude of preferring foreign taste for things has crippled many indigenous companies because of our assumed orientation that anything made here in Nigeria is of inferior quality /Aba-made which if compared with those imported goods we so desire,Aba-made is more durable but because we've channeled ourselves to thinking foreign is better than local we do not see any good in Aba-made. And in case it has skipped our minds , the more we import,the poorer we get because we are enriching others with our money in which through tax and all we are circulating our money and creating revenue for another country. We complain of not having good amenities yet we are not paying our tax, we are not creating wealth here. The Minister for Agriculture sometimes said that Nigeria spends several billions on the importation of ""TOMATO"" (land of Agriculture for that matter) . This is a huge shame and the earlier we realise our mistakes the better for us all.
. 
We want to be foreign so bad that we speak a certain way. We try to hide our accent which is part of our identity. We should understand that a Igbo person will have an Igbo accent, a Yoruba person will have a Yoruba accent, a French person will have a French accent, a Briton will have a British accent.Having your local accent does't make you unrefined or an illiterate.There is no problem whatsoever with that.

"Billionaire Owner Of Innoson Vehicles Withdraws Scholarship From Miss Joy Mmesoma Ejikeme For Forging Her JAMB Result
.............

Innoson Vehicles Withdraws Scholarship from Miss Joy Mmesoma Ejikeme Following UTME Score Manipulation.

In recent days, we have been involved in the process of investigating allegations surrounding the 2023 UTME examination results of one of our scholarship recipients, Miss Joy Mmesoma Ejikeme.

It was reported initially that Miss Joy scored exceptionally high on the exam, a feat that led to her being awarded a scholarship by our company.

However, subsequent reports of discrepancies in her UTME score led us to seek clarification from the Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB) and to allow her to voice her stance, we engaged in direct dialogue with Miss Joy.

Further to this, a committee set up by the Anambra State Governor, Dr. Charles Chukwuma Soludo, carried out a thorough independent investigation into this matter.

The findings from this rigorous investigation have now confirmed that Miss Joy Mmesoma Ejikeme did manipulate her UTME results.

This conclusion is deeply disappointing and stands in direct contravention of the values we hold dear at Innoson Vehicles, particularly those that underscore our scholarship program.

In line with these principles and response to the confirmed findings, we have made the difficult decision to withdraw the scholarship awarded to Miss Joy Mmesoma Ejikeme.

This action is a testament to our unyielding commitment to honesty, integrity, and merit-based recognition.

"Did you know about the health challenges the elderly face in Nigeria?

There is physical activity decreased with increasing age category, especially among men.

In Nigeria, older persons and their families face challenges in coping with functional physical and psychosocial health status of the aging process. 

These factors include changes in family dynamics, increased demand for medical services, increased economic stress, and decreased functional independence.

To prevent these challenges, at least 30 minutes a day, 5 days a week of moderate-intensity activity such as brisk walking may help.

"Innoson Vehicles Sue Imo State Government over N2.5B Debt

Nigeria's indigenous vehicle manufacturing company, Innoson Vehicles Manufacturing (IVM) has filed an over N2.5B lawsuit against the Imo State Government under the headship of Senator Hope Uzodinma over its failure to pay or service the debt of N2,547,666,435.00 (Two Billion, Five Hundred and Forty-Seven Million, Six Hundred and Sixty-Six Thousand, Four Hundred and Thirty-Five Naira) being the purchase price of the various IVM Vehicles including their parts which IVM manufactured, sold and delivered to the State Government but Imo State Governor or its government has refused and failed to pay same despite repeated demands and appeals.

The lawsuit which was filed by Prof Joseph N Mbadugha, SAN, FCPA of McCarthy Mbadugha & Co, the counsel to Innoson Vehicles coming against repeated attempts made by the Chairman of Innoson Vehicles Manufacturing, Chief Dr. Innocent Chukwuma OFR, to the Governor urging him to pay the company on the vehicles sold, and delivered to the State Government.

For the avoidance of doubt, sometimes in April 2021, His Excellency, the Executive Governor of Imo State, Senator Hope Uzodinma invited the Chairman/CEO of Innoson Vehicles, Chief Dr. Innocent Chukwuma to the Imo State Government House, Owerri where they discussed and agreed that Innoson Vehicles would sell and supply various specifications of its brand of Vehicles to the State Government which includes, inter alia;

1. 70 units of Innoson 5 Seater double cabin pick-up (IVM Carrier) 4WD

2. 10 units of Innoson 5- Seater double cabin military pick up (IVM G12)

3. 10 units of Innoson 5 seater single cabin military pick-up (IVM G12)

4. 100 units of a complete siren with public addressing system, revolving light, and street police light;

5. 2 Units of IVM Ambulance Vehicles

6. 20 Units of IVM G12 MS11

7. 20 sets of B. Canopy

"Innocent Ifediaso Chukwuma is a Nigerian business magnate and investor. He's the founder and CEO of Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing, Nigeria's first indigenous automobile manufacturing company.

Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing Co. Ltd. (commonly shortened to IVM) is headquartered in Nnewi, Anambra, Nigeria. 70% of the car parts are produced locally, while the rest is sourced from Japan, China, and Germany. "Press Release.
Innoson/BOSCH Trainees Graduates Tomorrow.

Tomorrow, Friday, April 29th, 2022, over 200 students who were Inducted into the BOSCH- Innoson Kiara Academy (IKA) training program in automobile maintenance for youths in the five (5) States of South Eastern Nigeria at Nnewi, Anambra State on 16th February 2021 will graduate from the 
BOSCH- Innoson Kiara Academy (IKA) training program. 

The graduation ceremony will take place at the premises of the Innoson Vehicles Manufacturing plant in Nnewi. 

The programs delivered at Innoson Kiara Academy are geared toward human capital development, poverty alleviation, and the production of skilled manpower for the Nigerian economy.

The collaboration of the Academy with Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing Company matches theoretical training in the classroom with functional practical exposure in the very well-equipped workshop of IVM and this makes the academy stand out among other TVET institutions in Nigeria. 
 
More so the Innoson Kiara Academy Curriculum is designed to give our graduates an all-inclusive educational experience and exposure that provides adequate skills acquisition and employability. 

Last year, Bosch partnered with Innoson Vehicles to train youths in the Southeastern States of Nigeria. The partnership is geared toward training over 200 youths in four spheres of auto-oriented disciplines: Auto Mechanic, Auto Elect, Auto fabrication and welding, and Auto spray painting. 

Furthermore, the trainees will also acquaint themselves with the use of the BOSCH Auto diagnostic machine which mainly detects mechanical and electrical faults in automobiles

The partnership will see the training of 2000 youths across the five southeastern states over three years. 

Upon graduation, Innoson Kiara Academy will support successful graduates who wish to be entrepreneurs to seek funds from the Central Bank of Nigeria to support the establishment of their respective auto maintenance workshops. 

Cornel Osigwe
Head, Corporate Communications and Affairs
IVM Innoson Group.

"‘We Are Looking Forward To Welcoming You To The Manufacturing Plant’ – Innoson Motors React As Soludo Promise To Use IVM Vehicles As Official Cars

Innoson Vehicles Manufacturing (IVM) has reacted to Anambra Governor-elect, Prof Charles Chukwuma Soludo promise to use Innoson Motors as his official vehicle immediately he takes over as the Governor of Anambra State.

Soludo who disclosed this on Wednesday during an interaction with the members of his transition committee, said he made the decision in order to “bring back the zeal of patronizing our own”.

Soludo during this interaction reassured the public of his campaign promise to only use as his official cars, vehicles made by Innoson Vehicles.

He said, “Igbo land is one and we must protect it. We want to bring back the zeal of patronizing our own. I have said it even during campaigns, and I meant it, that if I win, the official car of the governor of Anambra State will be Innoson motors.”

The governor-elect further stated that his wearing of local fabrics known as Akwete is not a coincidence, but has done so on purpose to support local firms and make a statement.

He said, “My Akwete dress is not just a dress, it’s a statement. I want to make a statement with it. You know, in the entire South-East, this is the only textile thing alive, and it’s handmade, by the women of Akwaete in Abia State.

“The dresses I will wear are those made in our place here. We must protect the things that are made in our place. Something is about to happen in Igboland, and together we will get there.”

However, reacting to Soludo’s gesture of using vehicles made by Innoson Motors as soon as he takes over from Obiano, the African automobile giant said, “Thank you Prof Chukwuma Soludo @ccsoludo for stating categorically that Innoson Vehicles will be your official vehicle during your term as Governor.

"Innocent Chukwuma expresses optimism that Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing Limited (IVM) would take over the Africa market in the nearest future.

Chukwuma said his “plans for the next five years is to see Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing Limited (IVM) everywhere in Africa.”

He said he had expanded his scope of production to a wide range of vehicles which include SUVs, wagons, commuter buses, among others.

“I need to correct one impression. While a lot of automobile companies in the country are assembly plants, ours is a manufacturing plant. We source most of our components locally. And that is the edge we have over others. If I see a local company that will add value to what we are doing through the production of components, I will patronize them.

“My plans for the next five years is to see IVM everywhere in Africa.”

"Obaseki And Innoson Partner To Convert PMS Vehicles To Run On CNG
.
.
.

Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) is becoming the future of vehicles and Edo State Governor Obaseki is moving to be at the forefront of efforts to run on this energy. To achieve this, he is partnering with Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing (IVM) who has positioned itself to take the lead converting vehicles using Premium Motor Spirit (PMS) to CGS.

The governor made this known when he welcomed the Chairman of IVM, Chief Innocent Chukwuma, on a courtesy visit to Government House, Benin City.

Obaseki told him that, “There is a big push to buy vehicles but a bigger push to convert vehicles using PMS to run on gas. Edo is the gas hub of the nation. We are ready to partner with Innoson to train young men and women to do the conversion. This can provide jobs for 1,000 youths. We can train youths on how to do this as we can’t continue with subsidies.”

The governor went on to commend Chief Innocent Chukwuma for pioneering car manufacturing in Nigeria and overcoming the challenges in the automobile industry; he said: “For us in Edo State, it is honourable for you to want to partner with us. Edo is a transportation hub and the second largest automobile market in the country. We have a large automobile market in the state.

In responding to this, the Chairman of IVM, Chief Chukwuma, said “We are ready to partner with the Edo State Government in converting PMS cars to CNG using the availability of electricity. We are ready to support the conversion of PMS vehicles to CNG in full as it is the only way the economy of Nigeria will survive.

“We are ready to train people to convert these cars. That is why we are here in Edo State. We will train youths on panel beating, auto-mechanic, painting and electricals, among others.
He said, “Nigerians are buying my vehicles. The vehicles and parts are cheaper because they are made in Nigeria. Governor Godwin Obaseki is working and developing the state to create a conducive environment for businesses to thrive in the state. Innoson Motors wants to also benefit from Edo State.”
.
.

"Do you know about Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing? Dr Innocent Ifediaso Chukwuma son of Mr & Mrs Chukwuma Mojekwu of Uru-Umudim, Nnewi, in Anambra State, Nigeria, developed the World’s First Black Owned Car Manufacturer. What he lacked in affluence, he made up for with intelligence, hard-work, discipline, and business acumen. In February 2007, Chukwuma incorporated INNOSON Vehicle Manufacturing Company Limited (IVM), to produce sundry commercial automobiles, utility vehicles and passenger cars, in collaboration with a consortium of Chinese auto manufacturer. The company is the first (indigenous) auto maker to produce truly Nigerian vehicles that are affordable and reliable.

"12th July 2021, Innoson Manufacturing Company unveiled two plants and an Automated Robotic Spraying Booth. The plants include the Innoson Small/Mini Bus Plant for manufacturing 1.5-litre engine capacity 7-seater and 10-seater buses and the Innocent Connect/Caris Plant for the production of sedan cars branded Innoson Connect and Innocent Caris.

These plants combined have the capacity to produce 32 thousand vehicles per year and would employ about 1000 Nigerians

These plants and the automated spraying booth were financed by the Bank of Industry to the tune of 4.6 billion naira  supported by the Nigerian Automotive Design and Develop Council (NADDC).

"IFEDIASO @60: An Ode to Chief Innocent Chukwuma

Chief Dr. Innocent Chukwuma is a man of few words. He is not your average businessman, he is a magician. When I mean “magician”, I mean one that wakes up to do the unbelievable, that seems “undoable” but the result ends up wowing everyone and building a template everyone follows. Beyond the story of his birth and the prophecy from his childhood, Ifediaso as he was called after his birth and was given as a title is a wonder that has since risen from the start of his business sojourn to his current state. He started out the very normal way, serving his masters till it was time for settlement.

The story of Ifediaso will never be complete without mentioning how he fared well as a servant, had great track records with his masters (His elder brother inclusive) he served and also eschewed great honest trait as a young trader that made the Igbo spiritual leader “Ogirisi Igbo”(Chief Rommy)  single him out as one that will be greater than his peers – which eventually came to fulfilment.

Nkwo Nnewi market, his first point of call was not just a business hub that made Ifediaso who he is, but his avant-garde business acumen made him revolutionize the market. The feat he achieved and the height he attained, none has been able to do or reach there till this very date. After conquering Africa’s biggest motorcycle market, Ifediaso looked elsewhere – it was the plastic industry, well dominated by the likes of Eleganza Plastic and others as of old. His “A-game” was brought to the fore, as he also did “magic” like he always does, took over the plastic industry and ended up erecting West Africa’s Largest Plastic plant. Ifediaso cannot brag of an MBA from great business schools of the world, but what he has been able to achieve with his massive native intelligence, a lot of people with MBAs haven’t done anything close to it. 

The automobile manufacturing business, to many brought Ifediaso to global limelight, but people who knew him before then, will testify that he has been doing big things from time immemorial. 

Read more at AnaedoOnline.ng

"AfDB President, Innoson Task Nigerians In Diaspora On National Development

 
President of the African Development Bank Dr Akinwumi Adesina and Mr Innocent Chukwuma, CEO of Innoson Group amongst other notable Nigerians have called for a conducive environment and formal structures back home to leverage the capitals, influence and connections of the Nigerian Diaspora.

The advice came at the just concluded 20th Annual General Meeting (AGM) of the Nigerians in Diaspora Organisation, Americas (NIDOA) with the theme, “Harnessing Diaspora Capital for Sustainable Development in Nigeria.

Nigeria’s High Commissioner to Canada, Amb. Adeyinka Asekun also led his voice urging Nigerians in Diaspora to key into efforts by the Federal Government to harness their resources directly for national development.

According to them, Nigeria’s emigrant communities are critical national assets mostly needed now to drive their country’s post-COVID-19 economic recovery efforts.

However, they called for a conducive environment and formal structures back home to leverage the capitals, influence and connections of the Nigerian Diaspora.

In a pre-recorded video message, Adesina highlighted the strong financial power of Nigerians abroad as shown in their remittances averaging $22 billion (N8 trillion) annually.

“Think of it. What this means is that Nigeria’s value added Diaspora is a significant net gain rather than a brain drain. “The Diaspora, however, is more than money of course.

The Diaspora represents knowledge, strategic influence and networks. “In a world of hyper change, Nigeria needs its best and brightest to tackle the most challenging issues of our time, and to ensure its rightful place in the League of Nations.

“Together, let us inspire a greater Nigeria, a developed, prosperous and dynamic country bursting with energy and hope,’’ he said.

Read more at anaedoonline.ng

"Community Policing: INNOSON Donates Operational Vehicles To The Police

 

In support of the ongoing efforts at restructuring the Force for optimal performance in the community policing level, the Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing (IVM) Company Limited has donated three (3) operational vehicles to the Nigeria Police Force, which was received on Tuesday, 25th August 2020 by the Inspector-General of Police, IGP Mohammed Adamu.

The vehicles, Innoson G12 Series, consisting of the Single Cabin Pick-up Truck MSI, Double Cabin Pick-up Truck MSII, and the SUV MSIII were presented to the Nigeria Police Force by Mr. Jonas Maduabuchukwu Ojukwu on behalf of Chief (Dr) Innocent I. Chukwuma and Management of Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing Company Limited in furtherance of their Corporate Social Responsibility, community support and other efforts directed at making the country peaceful, safe and secure.

The IGP, represented by the Deputy Inspector General of Police, Department of Operations, DIG Abdulmajid Ali, in his remarks, expressed his appreciation to Chief (Dr) Innocent I. Chukwuma, OFR and the Management of Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing Company Limited for their kind gesture towards the Force.

The Force PRO, DCP Frank Mba, in his statement, quoted the IGP saying that with public support of this nature, the Nigeria Police Force will no doubt be able to meet its operational and infrastructural needs in combating crimes and criminality in the country. He called on other well-meaning individuals and corporate bodies to emulate the gesture.

"Leverage On The Loan Facility Of Bank Of Industry, Innoson Advises Entrepreneurs

by Brown Ebubechukwuzuloke 

Nigeria First Automobile Manufacturer, Chief Dr. Innocent Chukwuma (OFR), has urged entrepreneurs especially the young people to take advantage of the credit facilities of Bank of Industry to help the growth of their businesses.

Delivering his speech during the 2nd Anniversary Lecture of AnaedoOnline, Chief Chukwuma said that he has gotten loans from Nigeria Bank of Industry more than ten (10) times.

While speaking, he noted that there are a lot of opportunities in Nigeria that young people can take advantage of, using their creative knowledge and skills.

“I advise our young entrepreneurs to make research, there are a lot of things that can be exported out of Nigeria”

“Nigeria is a land of opportunities, I started business during the days of my youth, I have used different creative concepts to build my businesses, I gave motorcycle spare parts business shape in Nigeria, when I ventured into manufacturing, I started with plastic manufacturing, after that, I moved into motorcycle tyre manufacturing, then later upgraded to vehicle manufacturing”

“I succeeded because of the innovation I brought into my businesses. In Africa today, my plastic company is number one, when I was trading on motorcycles, I reduced the price from One Hundred and Twenty Thousand (120) Naira to Sixty (60) thousand Naira”

“When I went into vehicle manufacturing, a lot of people told me about the stories of many vehicle manufacturing companies that have collapsed, but due to my research and study, I was able to understand how and why they failed, the lessons I draw from their failures and also my research, helped me to build what you have told as the First Vehicle Manufacturing Company in Nigeria”

While urging young entrepreneurs to use their creative knowledge and skills to develop and build businesses, he encouraged Nigeria entrepreneurs to leverage on the loan facility of Nigeria Bank of Industry (BOI), noting that he is one of the beneficiaries of BOI.

Read more at anaedoonline.ng

"Sierra Leone purchases Innoson Military vehicles

Sierra Leone Government has purchased some fleet of vehicles from Innoson Vehicles Manufacturing (IVM).

Some Government officials from Sierra Leone visited the Innoson factory in Nnewi on May 4th, 2019, prior to the purchase.

The visit was led by Hon Soloku, the Defence Minister and some other members of the West African country’s police force.

Sierra Leone Defence Ministry has revealed that the Innoson vehicles are intended for defence purposes.

Expressing interest in Innoson‘s fleets, the delegates communicated Sierra Leone’s plan to incorporate the Nigerian-assembled vehicles in the country’s military.

During the visit, Hon. Soloku requested that Innoson Vehicles should establish a company in Sierra Leone.

He noted that Africa has come of age and should begin to take care of itself without depending on foreign aid.

"Stop Antagonizing Innoson And Senator Ifeanyi Ubah, Igbo Leader Warns Social Media Users

 
The spiritual leader of the Igbo nation, Chief Rommy Ezeonwuka (Ogilisi Igbo) has fumed at what he described as “unguarded social media users” peddling false information to antagonise renowned Industrialist and Chairman/CEO Innoson Group of Companies Chief Innocent Chukwuma and Senator Uba by publishing false report that Senator Ifeanyi Ubah asked a Senate Committee not to allow the Senate patronize Innoson Vehicles.

Reacting to the report which has been making round in various social media platforms, Chief Ezeonwuka unleashed stern warning to those peddling the false report to stop it immediately or else he will unleash Ogilisi powers against them adding that he has made enquires through a competent source and discovered that Senator Uba at no point asked the Senate Committee not to approve the Senate to patronize Innoson Vehicle.

Chief Rommy Ezeonwuka (Ogilisi Igbo)
The Ogilisi Igbo who said that Ifeanyi Uba buys and uses Innoson Vehicles repeatedly warned those using social media platforms to spread rumors to antagonise and blackmail prominent Igbo businessmen and political leaders to henceforth stop it maintaining that as the spiritual leader of the Igbo nation, he will henceforth not take it lightly with anybody that uses social media platforms to antagonise and blackmail Ndigbo.

“Henceforth any person using social media to peddle rumors to antagonise or blackmail Innoson and Ifeanyi Uba or Ndigbo in general will have Ogilisi powers to contend with. Enough is Enough. I am using this opportunity to warn them to stop such acts and repent and learn how to use the social media platforms to promote Igbo culture, promote goodwill, promote respect for the elders and champion the cause of good governance and welfare of the people of Igboland like the Yoruba people do” he added.

"VENTILATORS for SALE!

In as much as this is quite encouraging and indeed a great relief to finally hear someone say this could be done locally; kudos!

My issue, however, is that 'you' would want the government to commit to it!
Waoh...people donated billions in this same country. Some even beds, holding centers and many other things. You don't produce ventilators, you've never been known to produce that other than automobiles. Don't you think that the world would have an issue believing you could actually produce one that would truly work?

If that's the case, it therefore means no gov't, no matter how desperate would give such, especially ours. The question would be ""can I commit to my great carpenter to make me my wedding suit since the order I placed wouldn't make it before the wedding?"". In otherwords, only a trial would convince a 'doubter'. Marketing 101; produce 5 or 10 at least if you can and give it out for free strategically, then watch if ORDERS wouldn't be placed. Thinking GLOBALLY now.

"UNIZIK To Confer Doctor Of Industrial Engineering To Innoson

The Chairman/CEO of IVM Innoson group, Chief Dr. Innocent Chukwuma will on Thursday, March 12th, 2020 be conferred Doctor of Industrial Engineering, Honoris Causa by the Senate and Council of Nnamdi Azikiwe University during its 14th convocation ceremony.

In a letter personally addressed to the IVM Innoson Group Chairman by the Vice-Chancellor of Nnamdi Azikiwe University, Prof Charles Esimone, the Vice-Chancellor stated that the “decision of Senate and Council is predicated on your enviable track record in the manufacturing sector of the Nigerian economy.Innoson

Senate and Council noted that after your secondary school education you had intended to study engineering in the University, however, while waiting for admission you fortuitously found yourself in the trading business for which you seemed to have flair, but the urge for engineering production never died in you.

This, combined with your innate business acumen, eventually led to your founding of Innoson Nigeria Ltd with Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing (IVM); Innoson Technical and Industrial Company Ltd; and General Tyres and Tubes Ltd; all four being manufacturing outfits, as subsidiaries, in furtherance of the Group’s vision of driving the Nigerian Economy Forward Through Industrialization.
Unizik to confer doctorate degree to Innoson

Today, the Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing is the only indigenous vehicle manufacturing company in Nigeria. In the light of the foregoing, Nnamdi Azikiwe University is proud to confer on you its Honorary Doctor of Industrial Engineering degree”. It must be noted that Chief Dr. Innocent Chukwuma OFR who is the Chancellor of Imo State University is a recipient of more than seven (7) doctorate degrees which includes; Honorary Doctor of Management Science from Nigerian Defence Academy (NDA) Kaduna; Honorary Doctorate Degree in... "INNOSON VEHICLES RELEASES NEW SET OF VEHICLES
WITH INDIGENOUS NAMES. 
Nigeria first indigenous vehicle manufacturing company ltd, Innoson Vehicles has released into the market three new set of vehicle brands. This was disclosed today, Friday December 6th 2019 in a press briefing at the company headquarters in Nnewi by the Chairman/CEO of Innoson vehicles Chief Dr Innocent Chukwuma OFR.

According to the Chairman, these new vehicles with efficient maintenance value are now more cost effective, fuel efficient, durable and , have improved technology.

The new vehicles include:

1. Innoson IVM Ikenga

IVM Ikenga is a perfect car for a family of more than five members  and has 7-Seater capacity. Its aerodynamic curves match the flow of the road, allowing you to feel the delight of a powerful and reliable car. It also comes with a 1.8l Engine and Turbo Charger for its manual transmission, and automatic transmission.

The car is purely a balance of economy and power. It has the capacity to achieve high power output, low fuel consumption, and low exhaust emissions.

2. IVM G20 Smart

IVM G20 Smart gives its user a Smart experience and it has some really exciting features for a vehicle in its class. It’s stylish, it’s spacious and it’s got seven seats combining the convenience and value of a family sedan with the power of an SUV. With all seats all up, the IVM G20 Smart is roomier and has naturally more cargo space.

This MPV Engine Capacity of 1.5L impresses with its fashion design, good quality, sophisticated technology and a reasonable price. This midsize MPV will inspire you.  This also would enable car lovers who love to name their cars as a pet name and maybe other names go happy.

If you diligently analyze social media’s initial reactions to the allegation that Mmesoma Ejikeme forged her Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB) examination result, it would be difficult not to conclude that her race was her wrong That she was wrong to have been born Igbo at a critical time like this Or that the politics of her race was her albatross EmmanuelIwuanyanwu FestusAdedayo Innosonmotor MmesomaEjikeme ObyEzekweseli
"I have read various posts online condemning the young Mmesoma who forged her jamb results
and I have something to say, it could be someone’s story, it could be so many people's story, especially those students who travel to miracle centers to write waec and jamb, ask them if they were not ignorantly lured into this same act For some of us, our parents expect much from us, they just place us under too much pressure via academics and most times the only option we have is to pass or pass, I remember my mother chasing me out of the house to go and get my hair cut, why? because from the second position I took fourth for the first time in secondary school and she believed it was because I was always concerned about my hair, did she even know how I got home that day after I saw my result? were my legs not too heavy because I know my mother too well Now for waec, I wrote thrice oh, same with jamb, even though I was the deputy senior prefect, represented my school in some competitions and was doing perfect academically, after writing the waec I had my maths result ceased, I had written jamb hoping that they would release the result but they didn’t, I took another waec the next year and by this time I was already working because my mother who was training eight children alone won’t consider paying for another waec and jamb for me, (I needed nobody to tell me that) I took the second waec and I remembered vividly how simple everything was to me, yet my maths was ceased again, even if any other subject was withheld I would combine them, but it was the same maths, the principal said it was over writing, that a student won’t possibly get all the ten question right with the time frame given, so the markers believed I did malpractice, I don’t know how true this is but I just know that I finished everything, I lost hope oh, it was my friends who encouraged me, this second time I had also written jamb and taken post utme at uniben, now for the third time, I had to rewrite again, I was extra careful, waec instructed us to answer ten questions in maths and I answered 7 and left the rest, I still had an A in maths and it was then I understood that I have really been over writing, I have been answering all the 10 questions all those while and ended up having my maths being ceased Now for my jamb, I had 246 or so, I was aspiring for med surg, and someone met me saying he can upgrade my jamb result to 300, I was so happy, I paid the man oh, I was working and had the money, my friends rushed into the mouth-watering offer too, after paying we didn’t have our scores upgraded, it was still the same and he kept telling us that jamb keeps changing abi upgrading their portal and the scores go back to normal I wasn’t able to get my score upgraded but I paid for it ignorantly Now I’m just wondering, what if he was able to change it to 300 or even higher, and maybe Jamb finds out that I was the best or my score was fake I didn’t consider that there will be any adverse effects or precautions, the man convinced me enough that it is what everyone does and even jamb officials collect money to help students perpetrate the act what do I know Honestly, being known as a very intelligent student who should get whatever course you are aspiring for is too bad and the pressure from some of our parents is something else too I will want to plead with everyone who is a lover of education and loves seeing young adults succeed, to stop making a mockery of Mmesoma and help her overcome this stigma Special thanks to the Igbo millionaire and crypto guru who came through for her, we can do better Sandra Micheal innosonmotor JAMB Sandra Micheal"

JAMB: Innoson Vehicles withdraws scholarship to Mmesoma InnosonVehicles has withdrawn the scholarship the company awarded JoyMmesomaEjikeme following her acknowledgment of forging JAMB UTME scoreThe company said it made the difficult decision to withdraw the scholarship awarded to Mmesoma, noting it was based on testament to its unyielding commitment to honesty, integrity, and merit-based recognition This was contained in a statement issued on Saturday by the Head of Corporate Communications and Affairs of the Innoson Group, Cornel Osigwe The company disclosed it was involved in the process of investigating allegations surrounding Mmesoma’s 2023 UTME examination results Osigwe said findings from the investigation have confirmed that Mmesoma manipulated her UTME results, lamenting that the conclusion was deeply disappointing and stands in direct contravention of the values Innoson Group holds, particularly as it relates to scholarship program The statement read: “In recent days, we have been involved in the process of investigating allegations surrounding the 2023 UTME examination results of one of our scholarship recipients, Miss Joy Mmesoma Ejikeme It was reported initially that Miss Joy scored exceptionally high on the exam, a feat that led to her being awarded a scholarship by our companyHowever, subsequent reports of discrepancies in her UTME score led us to seek clarification from the Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB) and to allow her to voice her stance, we engaged in direct dialogue with Miss Joy Further to this, a committee set up by the Anambra State Governor, Dr Charles Chukwuma Soludo, carried out a thorough independent investigation into this matterThe findings from this rigorous investigation have now confirmed that Miss Joy Mmesoma Ejikeme did manipulate her UTME results This conclusion is deeply disappointing and stands in direct contravention of the values we hold dear at Innoson Vehicles, particularly those that underscore our scholarship programIn line with these principles and response to the confirmed findings, we have made the difficult decision to withdraw the scholarship awarded to Miss Joy Mmesoma Ejikeme This action is a testament to our unyielding commitment to honesty, integrity, and merit-based recognition We acknowledge that this development is regrettable, and it has undoubtedly caused dismay among those who stood by Miss Joy, including her school principal and other well-meaning supporters However, it is crucial to maintain the integrity of our scholarship program and the values it representsInnoson Vehicles remains steadfast in its mission to support deserving students, invest in the future of our education sector, and uphold the highest ethical standards We have always been deeply committed to advancing educational excellence and upholding academic integrity through our scholarship program We believe in rewarding exceptional students who display not just academic prowess but also embody the values of honesty, transparency, and respect for the processes that govern our educational system We extend our appreciation to the public, JAMB, the Anambra State Governor’s committee, and all those who have shown understanding and support during this challenging situation We remain committed to fostering educational excellence in Nigeria mercyvlog

Have you heard of the innoson vehicles Innoson vehicles manufacturing co Ltd Is a Nigerian automobile manufacturer, headquartered in Nnewi Anambra, Nigeria It was founded by Innocent Chukwuma Nwala Innoson vehicle is nicknamed Price of African roadThe innoson automobile company was founded, 2007 The company was incorporated in July, 1987 and entered into a joint venture of assembling motorcycle in Nigeria with Chinese motorcycle manufacturer in They specialize in the manufacturing of motorcycles, tricycles, spare parts and accessoriesLooking for a more reliable vehicle, innoson could be your next optionThe innoson automobile industry made their vehicles topnotch and good in quality Why, Fuel Efficiency: All Innoson IVM are highly fuel efficient vehicles Being that petrol is a costly commodity in our country, Innoson vehicles brand of engines were specifically designed by its research engineers to consume less petrol/diesel and with an average fuel saving of between  IVM continually receives good feedback from their vehicle users who confessed that their Innoson vehicles do consume less fuel than other brands of foreign vehicles Warranty: All Innoson vehicles come with a 1 year engine, axles and gear warranty or 10000km warranty Upon purchase of any vehicle from Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing Co Ltd or any of its authorized dealers IVM is committed to being by your side by providing prompt and quality after sales service to you no matter your location As the first indigenous vehicle manufacturing company in Nigeria, it has a unique advantage in that vehicle spare parts are readily available IVM meets the warranty needs of its users through The Innoson IVM Mobile Workshop: The mobile workshop is a 24\/7 vehicle service workshop designed to provide prompt and quality after sales repair service to our customers IVM Mobile Workshop is handled by highly qualified technicians and mechanics and can travel to any location to provide prompt and quality vehicle servicing to our customers and clientsInnoson IVM Service Centers: The Service Centers are the authorized locations where the Innoson IVM Vehicles undergoes its services and other forms of maintenance schedules The purchase of original parts of Innoson vehicles can also be gotten from these service centers Low\/No Overheating: In trying to win the war against vehicle overheating, IVM added some extra important features that will reduce the chances of their vehicles from overheating These features includes i New Improved Thermostat: The new improved IVM thermostat which sits between the engine and the radiator has a metal valve that has a temperature sensor built in It can either be open or closed When the thermostat is closed, it keeps the coolant in the engine When the engine gets to a predetermined temperature, the thermostat opens allowing coolant to circulate With this, the circulation of coolant prevents the engine from overheating Double\/ Triple Fan: Another unique feature that makes IVM vehicles to avoid overheating is its double\/triple fans In responding to the Nigerian hot environment, IVM built in additional fans to the AC condenser together with the one of the radiator The AC condenser has two fans while the radiator has a big fan making it three set of fans This unique feature is one of the reason while IVM vehicles esp its buses and SUV hardly overheat Auto-Financing: Sourcing an auto-finance in Nigeria today has become a cumbersome task When you get, the interest rate and hidden charges deter some interested persons from purchasing a brand new vehicle through auto-finance IVM has been able to partner with some financial institutions such as Sterling bank, Diamond bank, Fidelity bank etc, to help in new vehicle purchase The repayment period is spread out over 36 months (3 years) allowing you the ease to pay the corresponding monthly amount for the particular vehicle you choose innosonmotor

"Have you heard of the innoson vehicles?

Innoson vehicles manufacturing co Ltd Is a Nigerian automobile manufacturer, headquartered in Nnewi Anambra, Nigeria It was founded by Innocent Chukwuma Nwala Innoson vehicle is nicknamed Price of African road

The innoson automobile company was founded, 2007 The company was incorporated in July, 1987 and entered into a joint venture of assembling motorcycle in Nigeria with Chinese motorcycle manufacturer in 1994

They specialize in the manufacturing of motorcycles, tricycles, spare parts and accessories

Looking for a more reliable vehicle, innoson could be your next option

The innoson automobile industry made their vehicles topnotch and good in quality Why, 

Fuel Efficiency: All Innoson IVM are highly fuel efficient vehicles Being that petrol is a costly commodity in our country, Innoson vehicles brand of engines were specifically designed by its research engineers to consume less petrol/diesel and with an average fuel saving of between 10%-15%
 IVM continually receives good feedback from their vehicle users who confessed that their Innoson vehicles do consume less fuel than other brands of foreign vehicles
 Warranty: All Innoson vehicles come with a 1 year engine, axles and gear warranty or 10000km warranty Upon purchase of any vehicle from Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing Co Ltd or any of its authorized dealers
 IVM is committed to being by your side by providing prompt and quality after sales service to you no matter your location As the first indigenous vehicle manufacturing company in Nigeria, it has a unique advantage in that vehicle spare parts are readily available IVM meets the warranty needs of its users through
 The Innoson IVM Mobile Workshop: The mobile workshop is a  vehicle service workshop designed to provide prompt and quality after sales repair service to our customers 
IVM Mobile Workshop is handled by highly qualified technicians and mechanics and can travel to any location to provide prompt and quality vehicle servicing to our customers and clients
Innoson IVM Service Centers: The Service Centers are the authorized locations where the Innoson IVM Vehicles undergoes its services and other forms of maintenance schedules The purchase of original parts of Innoson vehicles can also be gotten from these service centers Low/No Overheating: In trying to win the war against vehicle overheating, IVM added some extra important features that will reduce the chances of their vehicles from overheating These features includes;
i New Improved Thermostat: The new improved IVM thermostat which sits between the engine and the radiator has a metal valve that has a temperature sensor built in It can either be open or closed When the thermostat is closed, it keeps the coolant in the engine When the engine gets to a predetermined temperature, the thermostat opens allowing coolant to circulate With this, the circulation of coolant prevents the engine from overheating
Double Triple Fan: Another unique feature that makes IVM vehicles to avoid overheating is its double triple fans In responding to the Nigerian hot environment, IVM built in additional fans to the AC condenser together with the one of the radiator The AC condenser has two fans while the radiator has a big fan making it three set of fans This unique feature is one of the reason while IVM vehicles esp its buses and SUV hardly overheat
Auto-Financing: Sourcing an auto-finance in Nigeria today has become a cumbersome task When you get, the interest rate and hidden charges deter some interested persons from purchasing a brand new vehicle through auto-finance IVM has been able to partner with some financial institutions such as Sterling bank, Diamond bank, Fidelity bank  to help in new vehicle purchase 
The repayment period is spread out over 36 months years allowing you the ease to pay the corresponding monthly amount for the particular vehicle you choose

"FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE July 8, 2023 Innoson Vehicles Withdraws Scholarship from Miss Joy Mmesoma Ejikeme Following UTME Score ManipulationIn recent days, we have been involved in the process of investigating allegations surrounding the 2023 UTME examination results of one of our scholarship recipients, Miss Joy Mmesoma Ejikeme It was reported initially that Miss Joy scored exceptionally high on the exam, a feat that led to her being awarded a scholarship by our company However, subsequent reports of discrepancies in her UTME score led us to seek clarification from the Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB) and to allow her to voice her stance, we engaged in direct dialogue with Miss JoyFurther to this, a committee set up by the Anambra State Governor, Dr Charles Chukwuma Soludo, carried out a thorough independent investigation into this matter
The findings from this rigorous investigation have now confirmed that Miss Joy Mmesoma Ejikeme did manipulate her UTME results This conclusion is deeply disappointing and stands in direct contravention of the values we hold dear at Innoson Vehicles, particularly those that underscore our scholarship program
In line with these principles and response to the confirmed findings, we have made the difficult decision to withdraw the scholarship awarded to Miss Joy Mmesoma Ejikeme This action is a testament to our unyielding commitment to honesty, integrity, and merit-based recognition
We acknowledge that this development is regrettable, and it has undoubtedly caused dismay among those who stood by Miss Joy, including her school principal and other well-meaning supporters However, it is crucial to maintain the integrity of our scholarship program and the values it represents
Innoson Vehicles remains steadfast in its mission to support deserving students, invest in the future of our education sector, and uphold the highest ethical standards We have always been deeply committed to advancing educational excellence and upholding academic integrity through our scholarship program We believe in rewarding exceptional students who display not just academic prowess but also embody the values of honesty, transparency, and respect for the processes that govern our educational system
We extend our appreciation to the public, JAMB, the Anambra State Governor's committee, and all those who have shown understanding and support during this challenging situation We remain committed to fostering educational excellence in Nigeria

Thank you

Cornel Osigwe
Head of Corporate Communications & Affairs 
Innoson Group

"If you diligently analyze social media’s initial reactions to the allegation that Mmesoma Ejikeme forged her Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB) examination result, it would be difficult not to conclude that her race was her wrong That she was wrong to have been born Igbo at a critical time like this Or that the politics of her race was her albatross
EmmanuelIwuanyanwu FestusAdedayo Innosonmotor MmesomaEjikeme ObyEzekweseli"
"I have read various posts online condemning the young Mmesoma who forged her jamb resultsand I have something to say, it could be someone’s story, it could be so many people's story, especially those students who travel to miracle centers to write waec and jamb, ask them if they were not ignorantly lured into this same act For some of us, our parents expect much from us, they just place us under too much pressure via academics and most times the only option we have is to pass or pass, I remember my mother chasing me out of the house to go and get my hair cut, why? because from the second position I took fourth for the first time in secondary school and she believed it was because I was always concerned about my hair, did she even know how I got home that day after I saw my result? were my legs not too heavy because I know my mother too well Now for waec, I wrote thrice oh, same with jamb, even though I was the deputy senior prefect, represented my school in some competitions and was doing perfect academically, after writing the waec I had my maths result ceased, I had written jamb hoping that they would release the result but they didn’t, I took another waec the next year and by this time I was already working because my mother who was training eight children alone won’t consider paying for another waec and jamb for me, (I needed nobody to tell me that) I took the second waec and I remembered vividly how simple everything was to me, yet my maths was ceased again, even if any other subject was withheld I would combine them, but it was the same maths, the principal said it was over writing, that a student won’t possibly get all the ten question right with the time frame given, so the markers believed I did malpractice, I don’t know how true this is but I just know that I finished everything, I lost hope oh, it was my friends who encouraged me, this second time I had also written jamb and taken post utme at uniben, now for the third time, I had to rewrite again, I was extra careful, waec instructed us to answer ten questions in maths and I answered 7 and left the rest, I still had an A in maths and it was then I understood that I have really been over writing, I have been answering all the 10 questions all those while and ended up having my maths being ceased 
Now for my jamb, I had 246 or so, I was aspiring for med surg, and someone met me saying he can upgrade my jamb result to 300, I was so happy, I paid the man oh, I was working and had the money, my friends rushed into the mouth-watering offer too, after paying we didn’t have our scores upgraded, it was still the same and he kept telling us that jamb keeps changing abi upgrading their portal and the scores go back to normal I wasn’t able to get my score upgraded but I paid for it ignorantly 

Now I’m just wondering, what if he was able to change it to 300 or even higher, and maybe Jamb finds out that I was the best or my score was fake

I didn’t consider that there will be any adverse effects or precautions, the man convinced me enough that it is what everyone does and even jamb officials collect money to help students perpetrate the act what do I know
Honestly, being known as a very intelligent student who should get whatever course you are aspiring for is too bad and the pressure from some of our parents is something else too 

I will want to plead with everyone who is a lover of education and loves seeing young adults succeed, to stop making a mockery of Mmesoma and help her overcome this stigma 

Special thanks to the Igbo millionaire and crypto guru who came through for her, we can do better 

Sandra Micheal

JAMB

"Have you heard of the innoson vehicles?

Innoson vehicles manufacturing co Ltd Is a Nigerian automobile manufacturer, headquartered in Nnewi Anambra, Nigeria It was founded by Innocent Chukwuma Nwala Innoson vehicle is nicknamed Price of African road

The innoson automobile company was founded, 2007 The company was incorporated in July, 1987 and entered into a joint venture of assembling motorcycle in Nigeria with Chinese motorcycle manufacturer in 1994

They specialize in the manufacturing of motorcycles, tricycles, spare parts and accessories

Looking for a more reliable vehicle, innoson could be your next option

The innoson automobile industry made their vehicles topnotch and good in quality Why, 

Fuel Efficiency: All Innoson IVM are highly fuel efficient vehicles Being that petrol is a costly commodity in our country, Innoson vehicles brand of engines were specifically designed by its research engineers to consume less petrol/diesel and with an average fuel saving of between 10%-15%

 IVM continually receives good feedback from their vehicle users who confessed that their Innoson vehicles do consume less fuel than other brands of foreign vehicles

 Warranty: All Innoson vehicles come with a 1 year engine, axles and gear warranty or 10000km warranty Upon purchase of any vehicle from Innoson Vehicle Manufacturing Co Ltd or any of its authorized dealers

 IVM is committed to being by your side by providing prompt and quality after sales service to you no matter your location As the first indigenous vehicle manufacturing company in Nigeria, it has a unique advantage in that vehicle spare parts are readily available IVM meets the warranty needs of its users through

 The Innoson IVM Mobile Workshop: The mobile workshop is a 24\/7 vehicle service workshop designed to provide prompt and quality after sales repair service to our customers 

IVM Mobile Workshop is handled by highly qualified technicians and mechanics and can travel to any location to provide prompt and quality vehicle servicing to our customers and clients

Innoson IVM Service Centers: The Service Centers are the authorized locations where the Innoson IVM Vehicles undergoes its services and other forms of maintenance schedules The purchase of original parts of Innoson vehicles can also be gotten from these service centers

Low\/No Overheating: In trying to win the war against vehicle overheating, IVM added some extra important features that will reduce the chances of their vehicles from overheating These features includes;
i New Improved Thermostat: The new improved IVM thermostat which sits between the engine and the radiator has a metal valve that has a temperature sensor built in It can either be open or closed When the thermostat is closed, it keeps the coolant in the engine When the engine gets to a predetermined temperature, the thermostat opens allowing coolant to circulate With this, the circulation of coolant prevents the engine from overheating

ii Double\/ Triple Fan: Another unique feature that makes IVM vehicles to avoid overheating is its double\/triple fans In responding to the Nigerian hot environment, IVM built in additional fans to the AC condenser together with the one of the radiator The AC condenser has two fans while the radiator has a big fan making it three set of fans This unique feature is one of the reason while IVM vehicles esp its buses and SUV hardly overheat

Auto-Financing: Sourcing an auto-finance in Nigeria today has become a cumbersome task When you get, the interest rate and hidden charges deter some interested persons from purchasing a brand new vehicle through auto-finance IVM has been able to partner with some financial institutions such as Sterling bank, Diamond bank, Fidelity bank etc, to help in new vehicle purchase 
The repayment period is spread out over 36 months (3 years) allowing you the ease to pay the corresponding monthly amount for the particular vehicle you choose
